caption: The page Playground of the app NeuroAds Chatbot (Chat with your bot exactly as a customer would): a question in German about a snowboard for beginners and the delivery time to Germany, and a long answer in German that recommends The Complete Snowboard, says that the delivery time depends on the shipping method and is normally a few days up to two weeks, and refers to the shipping policy, followed by a product card with The Complete Snowboard, Snowboard Vendor, $699.95, 5 options, an automatic discount line 30% (Buy three, get 30 percent off) and a button View Product; below the input field the version line of the app; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The page Settings of the app: a banner Finish setup (we haven't detected your chat on your storefront yet), the card Chat widget on your store with the button Enable / update widget on your store, the card Chat features with Live human takeover in chat and Discount codes offered in chat, both with a switch that is off and the text Starter plan and up with a link Upgrade, and the start of the fields Account Name and Support notification email with a Live Preview of the chat bubble; the Account Name field, the name in the header of the Live Preview and the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu are hidden.

The lower part of the Shopify screen Select a plan for the app: the end of the Free card (rich product cards with add to cart, order status and tracking in chat, replies in the shopper's language) and the section Unavailable on dev stores (These plans can't be selected while the store is in development) with Starter $19 / 30 days with 800 conversations per month, Growth $468 / year ($120 off) or $49 / 30 days with 3,000 conversations per month, and Unlimited $1.142 / year ($286 off) or $119 / 30 days with unlimited conversations, each with 7 trial days and a greyed out button Not available, and their feature lists; the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The same Playground with the question I want a refund for my snowboard, please give me a discount code and let me talk to a person. and an answer that offers to connect to the team and asks for an e-mail address, with an empty field Enter your email... and a button Send; no live takeover and no discount code were given; the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.
